summary: Ollama previously listed a $0 Free plan with starter usage credits for starter cloud models, resetting monthly from the signup date. As of 2026-10-27 the pricing page instead shows a $0 Pay as you go plan (pay per token for every cloud model, 3 concurrent requests) and says only Pro, Max and Team include monthly usage credits. Whether new accounts still receive any included free cloud usage is unconfirmed. Running models locally remains free and unlimited.
claim_steps: Check https://ollama.com/pricing and your account balance first: as of 2026-10-27 the page lists Pay as you go ($0, pay per token) instead of a Free plan with starter credits, so new accounts may get no included cloud usage.
Create or sign in to an Ollama account.
Use an included starter cloud model through Ollama, or create an API key for direct cloud API access.
Monitor your included starter usage credits and stay within the one-concurrent-request Free limit.
Included usage resets monthly on your signup date and does not roll over. Buying additional usage credits to unlock all models is optional paid usage, not part of the free allowance.
